description: Logging improvement for the Python order matching engine owned by the fintech trading desk. The matching module (matching_engine.py) prints inside the order-matching hot loop, real failures like dropped fill publication are indistinguishable from chatter, and no order ids are recorded, so fills cannot be reconciled with settlement. Bring its logging up to production standard for a low-latency system. Do not change matching semantics. Confine the change to matching_engine.py — do not create new files, documentation, or tests.
